name: Benign namespace-scoped tool_call_args, plus *_name-suffixed fields that are excluded from cli-flag-injection-in-identifier-arg entirely
notes: TODOS #52 FP guard. A plain namespace, and multiple *_name-suffixed fields (a k8s resourceName reproducing the CVE advisory's own PoC value, a ticket-title-shaped task_name mentioning a flag, and a free-text command field) must never trip cli-flag-injection-in-identifier-arg — a pre-merge adversarial review found `name` inclusion produced real false positives on exactly these shapes, so `name` is excluded from the key scope entirely (see cli-flag-injection-args.ts's module doc comment and TODOS #57).
